title: State identification
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the air conditioner is in fan mode during the first 5 minutes.

title: Current calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the current as 1 A using I = P/U with the fan-mode power.

title: Cycle energy calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the energy consumed in one 15-minute cycle as 0.385 kW·h (or degrees).

title: Hourly energy calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the energy consumed in one hour as 1.54 kW·h (or degrees).

title: Power-time interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly interpret the power-time graph to determine the cycle structure and durations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly convert between minutes and hours for energy calculations.

title: Energy formula application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply W = P*t separately for cooling and fan modes before summing.

title: Cycles per hour
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may explicitly calculate the number of cycles in one hour (4 cycles).

title: Power mode confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize confusing cooling and fan mode powers when calculating current or energy.

title: Unit conversion error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize errors in converting time from minutes to hours for energy calculations.
